title: Bayesian additive regression trees predict AML outcomes without first-remission transplant
summary: A BART model integrating clinical and genomic data was built on 2550 intensively treated AML patients from the HARMONY database who did not receive allo-HSCT in first remission. Time-dependent AUC beat ELN2022 for 5-year overall survival (0.741 vs 0.700), relapse-free survival (0.752 vs 0.705) and cumulative relapse incidence (0.742 vs 0.708), confirmed in 714 UK-NCRI patients. Some ELN favorable-risk patients had predicted 5-year relapse above 40%.
ai_technology: Bayesian Additive Regression Trees integrating clinical variables and genomic aberrations
